name: Deepgram
description: Deepgram provider plugin for the AI module: speech-to-text (transcription) and text-to-speech. API credentials are stored via the Key module.
project_description: Deepgram registers the Deepgram speech service as a provider plugin for the Drupal AI module (drupal/ai). It exposes two operation types: speech_to_text (transcribing audio files, with options such as language detection, punctuation, diarization and smart formatting) and text_to_speech (generating realistic English speech from text using Deepgram's Aura voices). Because it plugs into the AI module's provider abstraction, any code or module that requests speech-to-text or text-to-speech through the AI module can use Deepgram without knowing about it directly, and it can be selected as an AI Automator step. A Deepgram account and API key are required; the key is held through the Key module. Sponsored by FreelyGive.
